Mia: Heads-up — flagged constraint for SOC2 launch: legal hold export needs per-tenant immutable snapshots for 7 years. Are we planning to support that in MVP?
Raj: Short answer: not in MVP. Our current storage model rotates logs after 90d into cold archive. Implementing immutable per-tenant snapshots is non-trivial — needs keystore escrow + retention-indexing.
Sara: Security note: for SOC2 we need chain-of-custody proof (signed manifests + KMS-backed sealing). If we can't provide immutable snapshots at GA, we need compensating controls documented.
Olivia: Legal: customers will push on e-discovery windows. We can negotiate carve-outs but need clear SLAs. What are the dev/ops effort estimates?
Raj: Ballpark: 3 sprints to add per-tenant retention indexes + export API endpoints, +1 sprint for KMS escrow handshake/workflow. So ~4 sprints with 2 engineers.
Tom: Sales update: two finserv pilots require 7yr retention + BYOK. One has regulatory gating and is P0 for Q3.
Mia: Proposal: phased launch. SOC2-beta: 90d retention + documented manual legal-hold export runbook (ops-assisted). SOC2-GA: automated immutable exports + BYOK escrow. Ship beta for Q3, GA in Q4.
Raj: Phased approach makes sense. Concern: manual exports create ops capacity risk — need SLA and playbook.
Sara: Add export queue monitoring and alerting to the risk register (missed export SLA = incident). Also require proof-of-delivery checksum for exports.
Olivia: Legal okay with manual exports if contract includes turnaround time, scope, and costs. We should template the contract language.
Mia: Action items: 1) I'll update the roadmap doc and launch criteria. 2) Raj to write RFC with tech options (S3 Object Lock vs append-only ledger vs DB-backed manifests) by EOD Fri. 3) Tom to surface pilot timelines to PM. 4) Olivia to draft contract clause.
deploy-bot: SOC2 checklist updated: added "manual-legal-hold-runbook" to docs :white_check_mark:
Raj: I'll include cost delta estimates in the RFC (storage + ops + export automation).
Mia: Thanks — scheduling decision review next Tue 10am. If no objections we'll proceed with the phased plan.
Mia: Closing thread.
